Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.reservoirproperties.materialbalance

package neqsim.pvtsimulation.reservoirproperties.materialbalance
Analytical reservoir material balance and aquifer influence functions.

This package provides "inverse" reservoir-surveillance tools that regress reserves and drive mechanism from measured pressure-versus-production history, complementing the forward tank models in neqsim.process.equipment.reservoir:

  • GasMaterialBalance - gas P/Z straight line (OGIP), Cole plot aquifer diagnostic, and Havlena-Odeh gas balance
  • OilMaterialBalance - Havlena-Odeh oil balance (OOIP), gas-cap ratio, water drive and Pirson drive indices
  • VanEverdingenHurstAquifer - radial aquifer influence functions, Carter-Tracy cumulative water influx, and ECLIPSE AQUTAB export
Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim
